items.title: Victoria's Secret (VSCO) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After Analysts Back Turnaround
items.summary: Victoria's Secret now carries a higher internal fair value estimate of US$89.20, up from US$65.56. This aligns with the cluster of Street price targets in roughly the US$75 to US$99 range. Recent analyst commentary points to this reset as a reflection of stronger earnings confidence around the turnaround, brand execution, and the current retail setup into 2026.
